title: Official El Niño Advisory: Pacific Anomaly +2.16°C
summary: NOAA Climate Prediction Center reports the Oceanic Niño Index (ONI) at +2.16°C for the JAS season. Atmospheric-oceanic coupling indicates El Niño conditions with very strong intensity.
source: NOAA Climate Prediction Center & DOST-PAGASA Climatology
actions: Maintain rainwater collection drums and optimize domestic water recycling
Follow municipal irrigation scheduling and Alternate Wetting & Drying protocols
Adjust planting schedules for drought-tolerant crop varieties

title: Severe Meteorological Drought Advisory: Agusan del Norte
summary: Agusan del Norte has recorded 4 consecutive months of rainfall deficit (-48%), accompanied by temperature anomalies of +1.4°C. Severe moisture depletion threatens rainfed rice, corn, and high-value crops.
source: DOST-PAGASA Drought Criteria & Bantay Composite Calculations
actions: Monitor soil moisture levels and practice mulching to preserve topsoil water
Adopt Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) in irrigated paddies
Follow local Department of Agriculture and LGU crop calendar advisories

title: Dry Spell Warning: Abra
summary: Persistent below-normal precipitation (-25%) for 3 consecutive months. Farmers are advised to prepare supplemental irrigation and protect shallow root crops.
actions: Inspect shallow tube wells and small farm reservoirs
Avoid midday field burning to prevent grass and brush fire spread

title: Angat Dam Reservoir Conservation Watch
summary: Angat Dam elevation is at 204.60m (seasonal rule curve: 210.00m, deficit: -5.40m). Inflows remain below historical normal. Water concessionaires and the National Irrigation Administration are calibrating releases.
source: DOST-PAGASA Hydrometeorology Division & National Irrigation Administration
actions: Practice domestic water conservation (minimize hose cleaning, reuse rinse water)
Report commercial water main leaks immediately to municipal concessionaires
Irrigation associations should adhere strictly to rotational canal distribution

title: International Disaster Coordination Notice: Red notification for tropical cyclone SIMON-26. Population affected by Category 1 (120 km/h) wind speeds or higher is 1.056 million .
summary: From 07/10/2026 to 07/10/2026, a Tropical Storm (maximum wind speed of 185 km/h) SIMON-26 was active in EastPacific. The cyclone affects these countries: Mexico (vulnerability Medium). Estimated population affected by category 1 (120 km/h) wind speed...
source: Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System (GDACS - UN/EC)
